keywords: Science and technology studies 2.History of science and technology 3.Science and technology and industry, nation, and policy 4.Science technology for globalization
educationalGoal: In the 18th and 19th centuries, scientific activity was institutionalized and professionalized, becoming "science." In this course, we will review the relationship between science and technology, and between science-technology and human society. Interactions among science, technology, and human society led to the social and environmental issues being experienced now. Upon completing this course, students will be able to establish their own viewpoints as engineers and/or scientists who support society.

lessons.content: How science and technology work: - Introduction to science and technology studies
Historical overviews on S&T 1: From “natural philosophy” to “science”
Historical overviews on S&T 2: Institutionalization and professionalization of science
(cont.) - Relationship between science, technology, and industry
Interactions between science, technology, and human society 1: Modern nations, and science and technology
(cont.) - War and science and society - Case studies
Interactions between science, technology, and human society 2: Economic development, and science and technology
(cont.) - Social distortion caused by economic growth - Economic globalization
Interactions between science, technology, and human society 3: Changing values
Social issues caused by science and technology: Environmental, information, and bio-ethics...
(cont.) - Difference between information technology and other technologies - Shift to an information-oriented society and issues caused by the shift
(cont.) - Issues related to bioscience and biotechnology - Social issues and SDGs
Wrap-up: science and technology in and for human society - What is required for scientists and/or engineers in today's society
Final reflection: - Summary of this course
